senses.gloss: f. (συνηγορία) defence, speaking in behalf of.—לִמֵּד ס׳ על to speak in defence of.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:4:2">Y. Taan. II, 65ᵈ</cite> top.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 6:1">Lev. R. s. 6</cite>, beg. [read:] <he>הדא רו״הק ס׳ היא מלמדת לכאן וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="G00452"><he>זכות</he></cite> being a gloss to our w.) that holy spirit speaks in defence of both sides; a. fr.
